whenToUse: Textured staging, like premium packaging or business cards.
Subtle headings that blend with the background.
whenNotToUse: Text that must be read (the contrast is very low).
Used as is in a dark theme.

alternatives.name: Neumorphism
alternatives.reason: A screen style on the same principle.

accessibility: Emboss has very low contrast, so use it only for decorative headings, never for informational text.
Screen readers should hear the same phrase as is, not the decorated letters.
The phrase keeps its meaning even with the decorative effect removed.
A toggle to compare with plain text shows the difference the effect makes.
